posts.title_en: Oven–Rye deck guide part 2 for players without Bari
posts.summary_en: 비푸맹 (168th, 3,201 pts, Elite Master 1, 30.46M) shares an Oven–Rye deck: his own Oven Wanderer is captain with ATK runes so it out-ATKs Milk, and the team runs 6 Skill Haste, so his Oven dives first and the enemy Bari and Oven, which dash at the highest-ATK enemy, chase it and bunch up for Strawberry Crepe and Rye. No Hound, because its knockback would break the bunch. His defense log (images 3-5) shows 13 defenses, 11 of them by 3000+ attackers; 12 held, 9 of the 11 3000+ attackers ran exactly the standard 12, and the only loss (−3) was to a Vampire–Bari–Oven deck with Mango Toucan and Fluffy Cheese Cat.

Own Oven as captain with ATK runes is that target, and with Oven's 50% skill-ready start plus more Skill Haste than enemies who run none, it lands first; enemy Bari and Oven follow it and bunch up, and Crepe plus Rye hit the bunch.

posts.title_en: Rye deck guide for players without Bari
posts.summary_en: 비푸맹 (254th, 2,834 pts, Elite Master 1; attack and defense both 23.85M) shares a Rye deck: Angel replaces Herb (casts fast with 3 Skill Haste lines and its synergy lasts the first turn) and Lime adds 연쇄 and crit synergy; the aim is to survive the Bari opening and win the long fight. Gives rune, gear and perk choices. The defense log shows 5 defenses at 2000+, all held (+1/+2, +175 medals each); of the 4 fully visible attackers, 3 ran the standard 12 and 1 a Rye-type list. A commenter who is server #1 with a charge deck reports about 80% after copying it.

posts.title_en: Do Rye decks really beat ranker Bari decks?
posts.summary_en: The poster's 4.5M Rye deck lost 5 straight to a ranker's Bari deck (5.01M per text). Image 2 is a defense-log entry in which that ranker (4.94M, 3,472 pts) beat the poster's defense (−2); the entry shows levels: Macaron, Pinot, Bari, Milk and Cherry Cola at 100, a Brightseeker-sprite card at 98, Oven, Pomegranate, Ion, Herb and Moon Rabbit at 93, Hound at 90. Commenters: Rye needs at least 5★ and those beating Bari run Rye 8★+, Rye must be top 3 by ATK to get Pomegranate's buff, and guild level 4 for the 10% DR perk is needed to survive the opening.

posts.title_en: Is Rye really the Bari counter?
posts.summary_en: A player who parks around 10th-30th in Rumble says nearly everyone between 10th and 50th runs Bari, he has seen only two or three Rye decks there and never lost to one. Commenters: Rye wins up to the upper-middle ranks; at the top, finished Bari decks (TSSR, TSSR and SSR carries against Rye's SR) out-power it and cut it before it warms up. One 12M Bari deck reportedly beat a 19M Rye deck.

counters.why: Deck power: the Bari deck's carries are two TSSR and one SSR against Rye's SR, so the gap grows with stars and setup.

disagreements: Bari stars: one commenter says 5★ Bari decks lose to Rye; another says 5★ is food and only 10★ matters; the first had never seen a 10★ on his server.

quotes.kr: 원래 중상위권까지는 호밀덱이 쌔고 최상위로 올라갈 수록 바리덱이 더 쌤
quotes.en: Rye is stronger up to the upper-middle; the higher you go, the stronger Bari gets.
My 12M Bari deck tears up Rye decks as high as 19M.
